name: Enshrouded Dedicated Server
description: Install the Enshrouded dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch enshrouded_server.exe directly without a shell.
known_limitations: Enshrouded stores its settings in a game-owned JSON document. GameNode currently exposes the file as metadata only and does not rewrite it with an unsafe generic JSON adapter.
The current server configuration uses queryPort 15637; older documentation may mention a separate gamePort, so GameNode does not register an unverified second port.
Automatic updates and generated save/log directory management are outside this template.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the Enshrouded server list.

variables.name: Player slots
variables.description: Maximum player slots; Enshrouded supports 1 to 16.

config_files.description: Generated server name, save/log directories, bind address, query port, slots, voice/text chat, and gameplay preset.

requirements.description: The current Steam dedicated-server depot is Windows-only.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.
The dedicated server is a 64-bit Windows executable.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 2278520 and launches enshrouded_server.exe directly.
notes: Start once to generate enshrouded_server.json, then configure the game-owned JSON while stopped.
The official default queryPort is UDP 15637 and slotCount is limited to 16.

findings.summary: The current adapter set supports XML, constrained INI, Unreal tuple data, and managed launch bindings, but not safe game-owned JSON editing.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
Sufficient storage for the server build and savegame
